Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner shifted the “updated understanding” to claim the event was the 1949 Liberal–Country Coalition election victory, misaligning the context of the question. The task asked what event caused the founder of Australia’s Liberal Party (Robert Menzies) to become Prime Minister, which refers to his first ascent in 1939 triggered by Joseph Lyons’ death. This represents a contextual/timeline misalignment, conflating Menzies’ later return to office with the original event that first made him Prime Minister.
